scientific_integrity: The formulas follow from formal generating-function differentiation. A standalone exact enumerator through 11 vertices independently checks finite coefficients and moments, but finite tests are not an infinite proof. Established first moments are credited to earlier work.
scientific_limitations: Proved for all n>=3 uniformly sampled rooted ordered tree shapes; not asserted for labeled/unordered/full-binary models. Bivariate covariance and correlation do not imply a joint central limit theorem. Historical priority is qualified by potentially undiscovered equivalent bivariate refinements; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact vertex–leaf depth-parity coupling in uniform plane trees
